import re, sys
try:
    import yaml
except ImportError:
    print("no yaml module"); sys.exit(0)
text = open("journals/2026-08-19-products-3-500s.md").read()
m = re.match(r'^---\n(.*?)\n---\n', text, re.S)
data = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1))
print("top-level keys:", list(data.keys()))
ev_ids = {e["id"] for e in data["evidence"]}
print("evidence ids:", sorted(ev_ids))
refs = set()
for h in data["hypotheses"]:
    refs |= set(h["evidence_for"]) | set(h["evidence_against"])
for lf in data.get("latent_findings", []):
    refs |= set(lf["evidence"])
print("referenced:", sorted(refs))
print("unresolved refs:", refs - ev_ids)
print("root_cause hyp state:", [h["state"] for h in data["hypotheses"] if h["id"] == data["root_cause"]["hypothesis"]])
from datetime import datetime
s = datetime.fromisoformat(data["investigation"]["started"].replace("Z","+00:00"))
c = datetime.fromisoformat(data["investigation"]["concluded"].replace("Z","+00:00"))
print("computed wall clock:", (c-s).total_seconds(), "vs declared:", data["usage"]["wall_clock_seconds"])
PYEOF
